$comment: commitwork/codeql-remediation.v1 — the two structured verdict shapes of the dual-agent CodeQL remediation pipeline (admin/routes/codeql-remediation.mjs). `analysis` is the independent first pass each agent produces; `cross` is the second pass after each agent has read the other's verdict. Enforced engine-side for the local model (LM Studio response_format.json_schema) and stated in the prompt for the claude -p agent, whose reply is shape-checked against the same fields. An unreadable schema FAILS the run — a silently free-form reply is the drift this file exists to stop.

investigation.description: what the finding actually is at this site — the code path, the data flow, what the rule matched

falsePositiveAnalysis.description: the explicit case for and against this being a false positive, and which side wins

remediation.description: the appropriate remediation in prose — or why none is needed / why a human must decide

diff.description: a unified diff (git apply, a/ b/ prefixes, repo-root relative) realising the remediation; empty string when classification is false-positive or needs-human

agreesWithPeer.description: whether, after re-analysis, this agent agrees with the other agent's classification

positionChanged.description: whether reading the other agent's verdict changed this agent's own position

response.description: this agent's analysis of the other agent's verdict — what it got right, what it missed

remediation.description: this agent's FINAL remediation position after cross-review

diff.description: the FINAL unified diff this agent stands behind; empty string when no code change is warranted
